boundary_2_feature_to_cta.verdict: clean gradual ramp, no pop at the handoff. In the pre-fix version this was 57.24 — a near-hard cut. Fixed by making each scene Frame opaque and extending the hold by +1 so the outgoing scene is still present on the frame the incoming reaches opacity 1.
boundary_2_feature_to_cta.correction_note: An earlier draft of this scorecard mislabelled f221->f222 as the hold-expiry frame. With hold = solo + XF_FRAMES + 1, the feature Sequence covers f90..f222, so the expiry is f222->f223. f221->f222 (11.42) is mid-dissolve.

repairs_applied_this_attempt: TitleScene / FeatureScene / CtaScene: added required backgroundColor prop, threaded from LaunchTemplate.renderScene. Each scene Frame is now opaque, so the cross-dissolve has a fully-opaque base to fade over. The 57.24 hard-cut pop at f221->f222 is gone.

LaunchTemplate positioned-scenes: hold is now solo + XF_FRAMES + 1 (was solo + XF_FRAMES). The +1 covers the frame on which the incoming scene reaches opacity 1; without it the outgoing scene vanished one frame early.

FeatureScene: bullet slide-in eased from 28px/22 frames to 22px/28 frames. The first render peaked at 27.75 content-diff (above the 2-25 gradual band); the new value peaks at 17.55 across the full video.
FeatureScene: 16px accent dots replaced with 56px numbered accent chips. Feature scene accent coverage went 0.07% -> 0.34%, into the same order as title (0.90%) and CTA (1.61%).

FeatureScene: bullet column is now flex: 1, max-width 1200px, with the text node flex: 1 + min-width 0. First render wrapped each feature per-word because the column collapsed to content width when no screenshot was provided.

CtaScene pill: removed the spring({frame: max(0, frame - 6)}) start delay. Measured: f208->f216 content-diff 0.00 in the prior version — the incoming scene contributed nothing for 6 frames of its own dissolve.
